title: 第2674章 陛下找了十多个面首第2673章 别在地上捡脏东西吃
lines: 一晃好几天过去了。
龙脉一点消息都没有。
宁宸等的有些不耐烦了，已经确定龙脉就在这附近，这么久了还没找到···宁宸不禁开始怀疑起这些术士的本事了。
也不怪宁宸着急。
柳枫说过，他的其他分身，正在逐渐苏醒。
他连续毁了柳枫两道神魂，所以柳枫想要九九归一，长生不老是不可能了···可若是剩下的七道神魂融合，鬼才知道会造就出什么样的怪物。
所以，他得抓紧时间，尽可能地在柳枫其他分身苏醒前将其解决，让龙脉恢复。
暂时没有龙脉的消息，宁宸来到林星儿和萧颜汐的营帐。
这地方条件艰苦，林星儿有了身孕，他想先让人护送林星儿回灵州，等宁安军到了，再会送她回京。
“王爷来得正好，我正准备去找你呢。”
看到宁宸进来，正在往外走的萧颜汐停下脚步，笑着说道。
宁宸看了一眼带着虎头帽，坐在炭盆跟前，正在小口吃着羊奶疙瘩的林星儿，莞尔失笑。
这个大馋丫头，这里条件苦了些，没什么能吃的，这羊奶疙瘩还是专门让人去村子里帮她找的。
他收回目光，看向萧颜汐，见她脸色犹豫又古怪，好奇地问道：“怎么了，出什么事了吗？”
萧颜汐犹豫了一下，小心翼翼地开口：“王爷，我说了你先别生气！”
宁宸奇怪地看着她，“说吧，什么事？”
萧颜汐一咬牙，道：“陛下找了十多个面首。”
宁宸表情倏地一僵，连林星儿都看了过来，她也是才听说，满脸惊讶。
“你说什么？”
宁宸怀疑自己听错了。
萧颜汐道：“刚刚接到京城那边传来的消息，陛下新纳了十多个面首，人已经带进宫里了。”
林星儿张着嘴，满脸惊讶，“萧姐姐这消息是不是太离谱了？”
“太初阁的消息，一般都会经过验证确认···再说这事京城都传遍了，不可能是假消息。”
林星儿吃惊道：“陛下跟王爷情比金坚，怎么可能接受面首？这么离谱的事情，反正我是不信。”
萧颜汐道：“我也不信，可事实就是如此！”
宁宸微微皱眉，“这些面首哪儿来的？”
“礼部献给陛下的！”
宁宸诧异，“冯高杰？”
萧颜汐点头。
“他为何突然献面首给陛下？”
萧颜汐道：“不清楚，但是礼部将进宫献艺的歌姬舞姬，都换成了男的···那些男的，一个个生得精美不凡，身材样貌那是个顶个的好。”
“陛下新纳的那十多个面首，就是从中挑出来的。”
林星儿忍不住问道：“有王爷生得好看吗？”
content_en:
Several days passed in a flash.
There is no news at all about Dragon Vein.
Ning Chen was a little impatient in waiting. He had already determined that the dragon vein was nearby, but he still hadn't found it after so long... Ning Chen couldn't help but start to doubt the abilities of these warlocks.
Don't blame Ning Chen for being anxious.
Liu Feng said that his other clones were gradually waking up.
He destroyed two of Liu Feng's souls in succession, so it was impossible for Liu Feng to achieve immortality... But if the remaining seven souls were to be fused, who knows what kind of monster would be created.
Therefore, he had to seize the time and try his best to solve Liu Feng's other clones before they woke up and let the dragon veins recover.
There was no news about Dragon Vein for the time being, so Ning Chen came to Lin Xinger and Xiao Yanxi's camp.
The conditions in this place are difficult, and Lin Xinger is pregnant. He wants to have someone escort Lin Xinger back to Lingzhou first, and then send her back to Beijing when the Ning'an Army arrives.
"Your Majesty, you came just in time. I was just about to go find you."
Seeing Ning Chen come in, Xiao Yanxi, who was walking out, stopped and said with a smile.
Ning Chen glanced at Lin Xing'er, who was wearing a tiger head hat and sitting in front of the charcoal pot, eating goat's milk lumps, and smiled.
This greedy girl, the conditions here are a bit harsh and there is nothing to eat, so someone had to go to the village to find this goat milk lump for her.
He retracted his gaze and looked at Xiao Yanxi. Seeing her hesitant and strange expression, he asked curiously: "What's wrong? Did something happen?"
Xiao Yanxi hesitated for a moment and then spoke cautiously: "Your Majesty, I told you not to be angry first!"
Ning Chen looked at her strangely, "Tell me, what's the matter?"
Xiao Yanxi gritted her teeth and said, "Your Majesty has found more than ten faces."
Ning Chen's expression suddenly froze, and even Lin Xing'er looked over. She had just heard about it, and her face was full of surprise.
"What did you say?"
Ning Chen suspected that he heard wrongly.
Xiao Yanxi said: "I just received news from the capital that your Majesty has received more than ten new faces, and they have been brought into the palace."
Lin Xinger opened her mouth with surprise on her face, "Is this news from Sister Xiao too outrageous?"
"News from Taichu Pavilion will usually be verified and confirmed... Besides, this matter has been spread throughout the capital, so it cannot be false news."
Lin Xing'er was surprised and said: "Your Majesty and the prince are in love with each other, how can you accept the interview? I don't believe such an outrageous thing."
Xiao Yanxi said: "I don't believe it either, but it is the truth!"
Ning Chen frowned slightly, "Where did these faces come from?"
"Dedicated to His Majesty by the Ministry of Rites!"
Ning Chen was surprised, "Feng Gaojie?"
Xiao Yanxi nodded.
"Why did he suddenly show his face to His Majesty?"
Xiao Yanxi said: "I don't know, but the Ministry of Rites replaced all the singers and dancers who performed in the palace with men... Those men are all exquisitely born, and their figures and looks are top-notch."
"The dozen or so heads that His Majesty accepted were chosen from among them."
Lin Xing'er couldn't help but ask: "Is there any prince who is good-looking?"
title_en: Chapter 2674 His Majesty found more than ten faces. Chapter 2673 Don’t pick up dirty things on the ground and eat them.
